WITH CONTRACT_MAPPING AS (
  SELECT 
      TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID 
      ,TOT.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID 
      ,ROOD.CONTRACT_CODE
      , BM.KEY_BOOK_ID_FROM
      ,BM.KEY_BOOK_ID_TO
  FROM (
    select a.agt_id as key_otc_trade_id,a.stati_cont_desc as internal_trade_id,b.rela_agt_id as key_book_id
    from pdata_n.t03_agt_stati_info_h a
    left join PDATA_N.T03_AGT_RELA_H b
      on a.agt_id = b.agt_id and b.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and b.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and b.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE'
    where a.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and a.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and a.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE'
  ) TOT
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT opt_comp_agt_id as KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID,Ext_Comp_No as CONTRACT_CODE,substr(Cutp_Pty_Id,8) as KEY_CTPTY_ID      
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO 
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OTC_OPTION_DEAL' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) ROOD 
    ON TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = ROOD.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
  INNER JOIN (
    select Src_Book_Map_Id as KEY_BOOK_MAPPING_ID,Sel_Cond as `CONDITION`,Oper as `OPERATOR`,Sel_Fld_Name as COLUMN_NAME 
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_AGT_MAP_REGU 
    where SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_BK_BOOK_MAPPING_RULE' 
  ) MR
    ON ((ROOD.CONTRACT_CODE = MR.`CONDITION`
    AND MR.`OPERATOR` = 'EQUAL'
    AND MR.COLUMN_NAME IN ('contractNo','合约编号'))
    OR (ROOD.CONTRACT_CODE LIKE '%'|| MR.`CONDITION` || '%'  AND MR.`OPERATOR` = 'IN'  AND MR.COLUMN_NAME IN ('contractNo','合约编号')))
  INNER JOIN (
    select Src_Book_Map_Id as ID,Book_Agt_Id as KEY_BOOK_ID_FROM,Rela_Book_Agt_Id as KEY_BOOK_ID_TO 
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_AGT_RELA_ADTNL_INFO 
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_BK_BOOK_MAPPING' 
      and strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) BM
    ON MR.KEY_BOOK_MAPPING_ID = BM.ID
    AND TOT.KEY_BOOK_ID = BM.KEY_BOOK_ID_FROM
  INNER JOIN (  
    select book_agt_id as key_book_id 
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO
    where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) rb 
    ON BM.KEY_BOOK_ID_TO = RB.KEY_BOOK_ID
  UNION 

  select  
    TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
   ,TOT.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID
   ,ROOD.CONTRACT_CODE
   ,BM.KEY_BOOK_ID_FROM
   ,BM.KEY_BOOK_ID_TO
  from (
    select a.agt_id as key_otc_trade_id,a.stati_cont_desc as internal_trade_id,b.rela_agt_id as key_book_id
    from pdata_n.t03_agt_stati_info_h a
    left join PDATA_N.T03_AGT_RELA_H b
      on a.agt_id = b.agt_id and b.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and b.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and b.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE'
    where a.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and a.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and a.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE'
  ) TOT
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT opt_comp_agt_id as KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID,Ext_Comp_No as CONTRACT_CODE,substr(Cutp_Pty_Id,8) as KEY_CTPTY_ID      
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO 
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OTC_OPTION_DEAL' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) ROOD 
    ON TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = ROOD.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
  INNER JOIN (
    select substr(a.Pty_Id,8) as ID,a.Shor_Name_Ch as SHORT_NAME,b.stati_subdv_cd as GROUP_FLAG
    from PDATA_N.T01_PTY_NAME a 
    left join PDATA_N.T01_PTY_STATI_INFO_H b 
      on a.Pty_Id = b.Pty_Id and b.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_COUNTER_PARTY'
      and b.pty_stati_info_type_cd = '75'
      and b.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
      and b.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    where a.SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_COUNTER_PARTY' and a.busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) rcp 
    ON ROOD.KEY_CTPTY_ID = RCP.ID 
    AND RCP.GROUP_FLAG = '0'
  INNER JOIN (
    select Src_Book_Map_Id as KEY_BOOK_MAPPING_ID,Sel_Cond as `CONDITION`,Oper as `OPERATOR`,Sel_Fld_Name as COLUMN_NAME 
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_AGT_MAP_REGU 
    where SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_BK_BOOK_MAPPING_RULE' 
  ) MR
    ON RCP.SHORT_NAME = MR.`CONDITION`
    AND MR.COLUMN_NAME = '交易对手'
  INNER JOIN (
    select Src_Book_Map_Id as ID,Book_Agt_Id as KEY_BOOK_ID_FROM,Rela_Book_Agt_Id as KEY_BOOK_ID_TO 
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_AGT_RELA_ADTNL_INFO 
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_BK_BOOK_MAPPING' 
      and strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) BM
    ON MR.KEY_BOOK_MAPPING_ID = BM.ID
    AND TOT.KEY_BOOK_ID = BM.KEY_BOOK_ID_FROM
  INNER JOIN (  
    select book_agt_id as key_book_id 
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) rb 
    ON BM.KEY_BOOK_ID_TO = RB.KEY_BOOK_ID
  UNION

  SELECT 
      TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID 
      ,TOT.INTERNAL_TRADE_ID 
      ,ROOD.CONTRACT_CODE
      ,BM.KEY_BOOK_ID_FROM
      ,BM.KEY_BOOK_ID_TO
  FROM (
    select a.agt_id as key_otc_trade_id,a.stati_cont_desc as internal_trade_id,b.rela_agt_id as key_book_id
    from pdata_n.t03_agt_stati_info_h a
    left join PDATA_N.T03_AGT_RELA_H b
      on a.agt_id = b.agt_id and b.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and b.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and b.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE'
    where a.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and a.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and a.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE'
  ) TOT
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT opt_comp_agt_id as KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID,Ext_Comp_No as CONTRACT_CODE,substr(Cutp_Pty_Id,8) as KEY_CTPTY_ID      
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO 
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OTC_OPTION_DEAL' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) ROOD 
    ON TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = ROOD.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
  INNER JOIN (
    select Src_Book_Map_Id as ID,Book_Agt_Id as KEY_BOOK_ID_FROM,Rela_Book_Agt_Id as KEY_BOOK_ID_TO 
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_AGT_RELA_ADTNL_INFO 
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_BK_BOOK_MAPPING' 
      and strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) BM
    ON TOT.KEY_BOOK_ID = BM.KEY_BOOK_ID_FROM
  INNER JOIN (  
    select book_agt_id as key_book_id 
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) rb 
    ON BM.KEY_BOOK_ID_TO = RB.KEY_BOOK_ID
  WHERE BM.ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT Src_Book_Map_Id FROM PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_AGT_MAP_REGU where SRC_TBL='ODATA_N_TIT.D_BK_BOOK_MAPPING_RULE' )
),
MAPPING AS (

  FROM (
    select agt_id as key_otc_trade_id,stati_cont_desc as internal_trade_id

    where strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE'
  ) TOT
  JOIN (
    SELECT opt_comp_agt_id as KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID,Ext_Comp_No as CONTRACT_CODE
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO 
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OTC_OPTION_DEAL' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) ROOD 
    ON TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = ROOD.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID 
  JOIN CONTRACT_MAPPING CM 
    ON TOT.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID = CM.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
)

   ,a.sub_trd_id                                                               as trade_id
   ,a.src_agt_type_cd                                                          as contract_type                     --期权合约类型
   ,a.src_agt_sub_type_cd                                                      as contract_sub_type                 --期权合约子类型

   ,a.cutp_pty_shor_name                                                       as counterparty                      --交易对手

                      when '2' then 'PRODUCT'
                      when '0' then 'INDIVIDUAL'
                      else  a.cutp_type_cd end                                 as ctpty_type                        --期权合约类型
   ,a.cutp_legal_enty                                                          as manager_name
   ,a.cutp_prd_id                                                              as ins_record_code
   ,a.encb_pric                                                                as barrierspct

   ,nvl(c.src_cd_val,a.sub_trd_trd_stat_cd)                                    as tradestatus

   ,null                                                                       as payment_freq                      
   ,null                                                                       as struct    
   ,null                                                                       as bundle_id                        
   ,rb.bel_dept                                                                as department
   ,rb.cntr                                                                    as desk
   ,a.obsv_scop_schd_end_date_str                                              as schedule_end_date
   ,a.auto_call_opt_fee_rate                                                   as autocall_premium_rate
   ,a.trmt_ki                                                                  as termination_knock_in
   ,a.obsv_scop_drop_qty_str                                                   as actual_settlement_qty
   ,if(nvl(rb_ori.mapping_wind_code,'')='',ri.summary_mapping,rb_ori.mapping_wind_code)    as underlying_summary_mapping  --汇总分类
   ,tot.business_type                                                                      as business_type               --业务类型
   ,rood.front_fee_payment_date                                                            as front_fee_payment_date      --前端费支付日
   ,rood.time_to_maturity                                                                  as time_to_maturity            --期限
   ,from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')                                  as data_time
   ,'${yyyy-MM-dd,-1e}'                                                                    as busi_date
from PDATA_N.T98_OTC_OPT_COMP_SUB_TRD_BASE_INFO a
  left join PDATA_N.REF_CD_CVT_MAP b                           --CONTR_STATUS 转码
    on a.opt_comp_stat_cd = b.dw_cd_val
    and b.tgt_tab_name = 'T03_AGT_STAT_H'
    and b.tgt_tab_fld  = 'Agt_Stat_Cd'
    and b.src_tab_name = 'REF_TRS'
    and b.src_fld_name = 'CONTR_STATUS'
    and b.src_sys_name = 'TIT'
  left join PDATA_N.REF_CD_CVT_MAP c                           --TRADESTATUS 转码
    on a.sub_trd_trd_stat_cd = c.dw_cd_val
    and c.tgt_tab_name = 'T98_OTC_OPT_COMP_SUB_TRD_BASE_INFO'
    and c.tgt_tab_fld  = 'Sub_Trd_Trd_Stat_Cd'
    and c.src_tab_name = 'V_RISK_OPTION_INFO'
    and c.src_fld_name = 'TRADESTATUS'
    and c.src_sys_name = 'TIT'
  left join (
    select agt_clas_cd as business_type,agt_id as key_otc_trade_id
    from PDATA_N.T03_AGT_CLAS_H  
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_TRD_OTC_TRADE'
      and strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) tot
    ON a.opt_comp_agt_id = tot.key_otc_trade_id
  left join MAPPING ON a.opt_comp_agt_id = MAPPING.KEY_OTC_TRADE_ID
  left join (
    select book_agt_id as key_book_id,map_undrl_cd as mapping_wind_code
    from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO
    where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) rb_ori 
    on mapping.key_book_id_from = rb_ori.key_book_id
  left join (
      select opt_comp_agt_id as key_otc_trade_id,src_prd_id as underlying_ins_id,bask_type as basket_type
      from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_STRU_ELMN_INFO 
      where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OPTION_DEAL_STRUCTURE'
        and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) rods  
    on a.opt_comp_agt_id = rods.key_otc_trade_id
  left join (
      select opt_comp_agt_id as key_otc_trade_id,fred_fee_paid_date as front_fee_payment_date,term_days as time_to_maturity
      from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_OPT_COMP_INFO
      where src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_OTC_OPTION_DEAL'
        and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) rood
    ON tot.key_otc_trade_id = ROOD.key_otc_trade_id
  left join (
        select in_code as key_instrument_id,undrl_clas as summary_mapping 
        from pdata_news_n.t02_tit_scr_base_info 
        where src_id = 'TIT' and grp_id = '01' 
  ) RI  
    ON rods.underlying_ins_id = ri.key_instrument_id
  left join (
      select a.book_agt_id,a.bel_dept,a.cntr,b.agt_full_name
      from PDATA_N.T03_OTC_DERI_BOOK_ADTNL_INFO a
      left join PDATA_N.T03_AGT_NAME_H b 
        on a.book_agt_id = b.agt_id and b.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and b.strt_date <= '${yyyy-MM-dd}' and b.end_date > '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
      where a.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_REF_BOOK' and busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
  ) rb 
    on MAPPING.KEY_BOOK_ID_TO = RB.book_agt_id
where a.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TIT.D_V_RISK_OPTION_INFO'
  and a.busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}' 
	) castTable
